description: The newest published items: by default the newest VI Update articles, the newest Good Day, This Week edition and the newest Straight Record edition; or the newest items of one publication. Use for "what is new" or for current coverage. Each item has an id for fetch, its date, headlines or an excerpt, a URL and a citeAs line.

limit.description: How many items per publication, 1 to 20. Default 5 for VI Update and 1 for each edition series when all three are asked for; 5 for one publication.

section.description: One publication: "vi_update", "good_day" or "straight_record". Default: all three.

name: latest
title: Latest from each publication
